method: Actual generated floor-five arena; controlled disclosed fixture; World.frame only after setup; boss/cue/projectile observation delay is real-time, skill attacks press once then release. No damage injection, invulnerability, healing, ammo, consumables or runtime teleports. Config-derived HP. Deterministic policy evidence, not a human balance or usability verdict.

fullArchive.note: Full detailed history retained in the audit working directory, outside repository docs.

fixtureDefinitions.common: All floor5, no ammunition or consumables. Warrior except read-knife=huntress. Exact weapon shown per row. No talents unless listed; full-clear describes an XP/build fixture, not a campaign playthrough. maxWorldTime120/maxRealTime300; stationary holds fixed yaw; ordinary approaches start6m, stop1.2m. Current HP values are recorded measurements; harness derives them from configuration.

baseline.name: baseline-red-before-pressure-fix
baseline.rationale: Original32HP boss with renewable held-input Counter and axe windup-reset loop.

candidates.name: 80hp-v1
candidates.rationale: First mechanical correction: real press-at-cue Counter, bounded interruption, close approach and phase-two two-cleave commitment. HP80, cleave6/followup8/rush6/lance4. Base blind strategies fail but216/216 common sword+2/leather+2 approach sensitivity rows still clear, so progression pressure remained weak.

candidates.name: 80hp-v2
candidates.rationale: Pressure trial: cleave8/followup10/rush8/lance4. Common split approach loses, but followup10 would kill a full-health base10HP player in one hit. Rejected that unnecessary fairness cost.

final.name: 80hp-v3-survivable-single-hit
final.rationale: Retain mechanics and80HP, keep every melee hit8 and lance4. A full-health starting10HP character survives any single hit. Common sword+2/leather+2 blind walk is no longer reliably safe, while high-investment Lv9/toughness builds may still trade health for damage. Deliberate real-press and no-ammo routes remain viable across frame rates and observation delay.
importantLimits: All54 core deliberate routes and42 full-campaign deliberate routes clear; this is deterministic simulation evidence, not proof of human difficulty.

The zero-ammo base-knife conservative route takes about70world seconds. Tighter spacing plus two punish hits can approach35.6seconds under0ms reaction at60/120FPS, but the conservative120/200ms route still takes about70seconds.

Lv9/26HP split gear clears12/12 blind approach rows and30HP+toughness/combo also clears12/12. These earned builds may afford trading; the acceptance criteria do not require every geared blind policy to die.

Movement/yaw decisions and official Counter cue are derived from visible-state snapshots with specified real-time latency. Aim and arena geometry are exact. NPC internals such as HP do not determine inputs.
No screenshots, mobile/controller usability, browser presentation, full campaign playthrough or human feel assessment was performed by this harness.

compactResults.outcomeLegend: clear=boss defeated; dead=player died; timeout=finite bound reached with both alive; choice-block=unexpected pending choice

clearOutliers.note: Every successful blind sensitivity row is retained, including the36/216 surviving rows in each upgraded build; failed/dead rows remain counted above and in full archive.

reproduction.matrix: Bundle tests/wardenPressureScenarios.ts with installed esbuild (platform node, format esm), import it and call wardenPressureMatrix().
reproduction.scenario: Call runWardenPressureScenario(options), matching policy, build, fixture weapon/cls/startDistance/stopDistance/talents, fps, seed, reaction, attackDelay, recoveryHits and dodgeMargin from a row.
reproduction.sensitivity: Cartesian product as stated in sensitivity method; full campaign uses full-clear-split/full-clear-offense, [] or [toughness,combo] for warrior, no talents for huntress.
reproduction.limitations: Exact aim, known arena geometry and config timings. No human input/visual/feel/mobile validation, and no full-campaign playthrough. XP/equipment/talent fixtures are set before simulation and disclosed; progression choices cleared only during fixture setup. Extra knife punish fits entire action within observed opening minus real-time latency allowance. Summary damage is damage events, including lethal overkill, not capped HP lost.
